page.overview:
Who is Clavia?

When first meets , it takes her a moment to realize that he is a traveler. She is eager to share something with him, but if Link decides to leave instead, she considers it a shame. If decides to listen to her, will point to the cliffs of and explain that she found a note in an old at her . The note holds cryptic instructions to a trial. Although admits that she does not understand the words, she guesses that the note refers to and excitedly thinks of the possibility of treasure waiting there. However, she is quick to recall with dismay that she has parental responsibilities and must remain in .

As with other villagers in , will react to the if speaks to her while carrying it. She recognizes it as the one uses, and she suggests he hurry along with his delivery.
